summary: Regression smoke test after Vercel config file moves. Verified file layout on disk (frontend/api/extract-booking.js, frontend/.npmrc, frontend/vercel.json exist and are valid; /app/api and /app/vercel.json removed). Backend AI extraction endpoint POST /api/extract-booking returns 200 with correct parsed booking (Ali / Al Hadi Farm / Evening / remainingPayment=13000). All 7 frontend routes (/, /ai-booking, /bookings, /receipt/:id, /settings, /calendar, /backup) load HTTP 200 with no console errors. Emergent preview app is fully functional post-refactor.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/vercel.json rewrites: the rule { source: '/api/(.*)', destination: '/api/$1' } is effectively a no-op — Vercel already routes /api/* to the functions folder automatically. The rule is harmless but redundant.

The Vercel serverless function at frontend/api/extract-booking.js is a duplicate implementation of what /app/backend/server.py POST /api/extract-booking does with emergentintegrations. On the Emergent preview these two do NOT collide (preview uses FastAPI), but be aware they diverge in provider (Vercel function uses GEMINI/OPENAI, backend uses GPT-5.2 via emergent LLM key). Keep them in sync or document the split.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Config-only iteration. All routes and backend AI extract still work end-to-end on the Emergent preview. Vercel-specific deployment cannot be validated from this environment.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. File moves and .npmrc/vercel.json placement are correct; nothing regressed.
